entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer service. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return something. I'm not happy at all. This is ridiculous!
I understand your frustration. I'm happy to help process your return. Can you tell me what item you're looking to return?
It's this VeloBand Pulse. It's supposed to be a smart watch but it barely works! I'm so annoyed. I bought it a couple weeks ago.
Okay, the VeloBand Pulse. And approximately how long ago was your purchase?
I don't know, like 15 days? Maybe a little less, but around there. I want my money back! Your products are terrible.

I apologize that you're not satisfied with the VeloBand Pulse. Let me check our return policy for you. Our standard policy allows for returns up to 90 days from the purchase date, so you're well within that window.
I can process a full refund for you. To proceed, could you provide me with your order number or the email address associated with the purchase?
Finally! About time. Here's my email: angrycustomer@email.com

Thank you. Please allow me a moment to pull up your order. ... Okay, I have located your purchase of the VeloBand Pulse. I have initiated the return process and a full refund will be credited back to your original payment method within 7-10 business days.
7-10 days? Seriously? This whole thing has been a pain. But okay, as long as I get my money back.

I understand your impatience. You will receive an email confirmation of the return within the next 24 hours. This email will also contain instructions on how to ship the VeloBand Pulse back to us. You can use the pre-paid shipping label included in the email. You don't need to speak with a manager to process this return.
So, I just pack it up, slap on the label, and send it back? That's it?
Exactly. Once we receive the returned item, the refund process will complete. Again, I apologize for any inconvenience. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, I think that's it. Thanks for finally sorting this out. I was really worried I was going to be stuck with this useless thing. At least the return policy is good.
You're very welcome. We value your business. Have a great day!
